title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
description: Cybersecurity Fundamentals covers security principles, threats, architecture, cryptography, networks, identity, endpoints, web and cloud security, vulnerability management, security operations, incident response, risk, privacy, awareness, and an integrated defensive capstone.

topics.title: Security Mindset, CIA Triad, and Defense-in-Depth
topics.description: Build the core security vocabulary and judgment students need to evaluate confidentiality, integrity, availability, layered controls, and tradeoffs.

children.title: Conceptual Foundations of Security Mindset, CIA Triad, and Defense-in-Depth
children.description: This subtopic gives students the vocabulary and mental model needed to reason about security decisions before choosing tools or controls.

children.title: Methods and Tools for Security Mindset, CIA Triad, and Defense-in-Depth
children.description: This subtopic turns the concept into professional practice through frameworks, configurations, labs, analysis, documentation, and operational workflows.

children.title: Applied Security Use of Security Mindset, CIA Triad, and Defense-in-Depth
children.description: This subtopic emphasizes how the topic protects systems, people, data, operations, trust, and organizational resilience.
